page_title: MNU 0-3 BOU | Manchester Utd v Bournemouth 22/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) takes a short corner kick.

90+5' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) attempts to release Alejandro Garnacho with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Manchester Utd.

90+2' Leny Yoro (Manchester United) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. Kepa Arrizabalaga is alert and denies him with a nice save.
90+1' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth) for his blatant foul.
90+1' David Brooks (Bournemouth) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Foul! James Hill (Bournemouth) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
89' Andoni Iraola has decided to substitute Tyler Adams and he is replaced by James Hill (Bournemouth).
89' It is time for a substitution. David Brooks (Bournemouth) is on for Antoine Semenyo.

86' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.

83' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
82' Craig Pawson has issued a yellow card to Kepa Arrizabalaga (Bournemouth).
82' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United).

82' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Manchester Utd.

81' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
81' The total number of attempts is 18:8.
80' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
78' Here comes a substitution. Justin Kluivert is given a rest as he is replaced by Philip Billing (Bournemouth).
77' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
77' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Good work from Manchester Utd as they win a corner.
75' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) was too forceful with his tackle and Craig Pawson interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
74' A pass by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

73' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
73' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) sends a cross into the box, but Kepa Arrizabalaga comes off his line to gather the ball.
73' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

73' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Manchester Utd will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
71' It will be a substitution. Enes Unal (Bournemouth) is ready to enter the pitch as Evanilson walks off.
70' A dangerous looking corner kick from Amad Diallo (Manchester United) is cleared to safety by the defence.

69' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the bottom right corner lacks power and Kepa Arrizabalaga easily makes the save. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Manchester Utd will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
69' The ball is cleared after Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
68' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

68' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Manchester Utd force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

65' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom right corner is blocked by Kepa Arrizabalaga, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.

63' 0 - 3 Dango Ouattara produces a sweet pass and picks out Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the middle of the net and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 0:3!
61' 0 - 2 Goal! Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Andre Onana into the roof of the net.
61' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is going to take the penalty!
60' Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul after Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) hacks down one of his opponents. PENALTY to Bournemouth!
59' The current number of shots on goal is 3:3.
56' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

56' Leny Yoro (Manchester United) rose high to meet a perfectly taken corner kick and attempted to steer a fine header from inside the box towards the left side of the goal. Nobody knows what would have happened if one of the defending players hadn’t pulled off a brilliant intervention to block the effort. Manchester Utd get a corner.
55' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
55' Ruben Amorim prepares a substitution. Manuel Ugarte is replaced by Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United).
54' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joshua Zirkzee leaves the pitch and Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) comes on.

54' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd will have a chance to score from a corner.
54' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
53' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
52' Bournemouth control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
49' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
48' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Lewis Cook (Bournemouth), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bournemouth.
47' Evanilson (Bournemouth) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
46' Here is a change. Tyrell Malacia is going off and Ruben Amorim gives the last tactical orders to Leny Yoro (Manchester United).
46' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) comes onto the pitch so that Adam Smith can be given a rest.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

45' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) skips past the defender inside the box and blasts the ball at goal, but sends the effort well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
45' Ball possession – 53:47.

44' What a chance that is! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
43' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
42' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away. Manchester Utd force their opponents to concede a corner.

42' That was a nice football moment. Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the right post. Kepa Arrizabalaga guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!

41' Fine attempt! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
39' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
38' Craig Pawson blows for a foul after Tyrell Malacia (Manchester United) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
37' Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

36' A precise cross towards the penalty spot was latched onto by Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United). He outjumped the defence and produced a decent header which went a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
36' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) works the corner short.
36' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
35' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Craig Pawson didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
34' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) steps up and sends the free kick straight into the defensive wall.

33' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Craig Pawson has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Manchester Utd are awarded the free kick.
32' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) takes the corner but it's cleared.
32' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Amad Diallo (Manchester United). The linesman points to the corner flag, Manchester Utd are going to take it.
32' Evanilson (Bournemouth) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going low in the middle of the goal, but Andre Onana has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
29' 0 - 1 The ball from the free kick finds its way to Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth) who rises and scores with a thunderous header inside the left post. An incredible long-range header!
29' Tyrell Malacia (Manchester United) tackles a bit over-zealously and Craig Pawson blows for a foul.
28' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
27' The corner from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is intercepted by the defence.
27' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Manchester Utd win a corner.
25' A shot from the edge of the box by Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is a waste and goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
24' Craig Pawson couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Harry Maguire (Manchester United) and blew his whistle.
22' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
21' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Andre Onana intercepts the ball.
21' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
18' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Kepa Arrizabalaga.
18' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
16' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
15' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Milos Kerkez, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
14' The free kick is delivered by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
13' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Craig Pawson saw the whole situation. Manchester Utd are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
13' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
12' Craig Pawson interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Ryan Christie (Bournemouth).
11' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) is flagged for offside.
11' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
10' Craig Pawson blows his whistle and signals a foul after Harry Maguire (Manchester United) brought his opponent down. That's a free kick to Bournemouth.
9' A pass finds the feet of Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) on the edge of the box and he sends in a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's easily gathered by the goalkeeper.
9' It looks like Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) saw red with that tackle. Craig Pawson won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

6' Kepa Arrizabalaga was forced into action to thwart Amad Diallo (Manchester United). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
2' Andre Onana displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Evanilson (Bournemouth) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
1' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Bournemouth will kick-off.
Craig Pawson will officiate today.
